title: command.form.checks props, contract version 1
description: The props of the checks of the generic command form, a form check point (PRD 13.4): none. A contribution to it is a pure function of the form's command document to issues, run on every edit of the form of the command it names; an issue of severity error blocks the submit only for a check that mirrors a hook of its addon on the same command. The PHP form is Cbox\Cms\Panel\CommandForm\Domain\Dto\CommandFormChecksV1.
